digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate blocking and T10 DET overlay
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria must transition from non-blocking to blocking with block_threshold 0.90 and findings above threshold must block while those below remain advisory

T10 DetGateRule (infra-vocabulary) must match terraform, cloudformation, pulumi, ansible, kubernetes, helm, k8s, iac, aws service names, github workflows, and related infrastructure keywords to pre-gate T10 LLM routing on infra-touching plans

T10 severity guidance must restrict MAJOR severity to only destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret, and unauthenticated internet-reachable service findings to prevent lesser findings from reaching 0.90 priority threshold
Pinned routing table and approved-blocking-criteria set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py must be updated to reflect T3 and T10 as blocking criteria
T10 DetGateRule must fire on terraform and GitHub Actions fixtures and det-gate non-infrastructure plans with zero LLM routing
